Understand the process

What Is a Dating Mentor?

A dating mentor is someone objective you can turn to throughout the dating process, someone who listens carefully, asks thoughtful questions, and helps you gain clarity on the decisions and challenges you face.

Whether you are unsure how to approach a situation, wondering what questions to ask, trying to understand your feelings, or needing help thinking clearly, dating mentoring gives you a private, supportive place to talk things through.

It is not about telling you what to do. It is about helping you develop the clarity and confidence to make informed decisions for yourself.

Dating mentoring is not therapy or counselling. It is practical, warm, one-to-one support from someone who understands the process and wants to help you feel more confident and clear as you navigate it.

Meet Your Mentor

Hi, I'm Marisa Tuchinsky

Warm, practical, and in your corner

My passion for dating mentorship comes from seeing firsthand how important healthy relationships and thoughtful decision-making can be. Over the years, I have developed a deep appreciation for the challenges that singles face as they navigate dating and relationship decisions.

I understand that dating can bring uncertainty, questions, and difficult choices. Sometimes the most valuable thing is having someone objective to help you sort through your thoughts, gain perspective, and make decisions that align with your values and goals.

My approach is warm, practical, and supportive. I strive to help clients think clearly, communicate effectively, and move forward with confidence.

My goal is not to tell people what to do, but to help them develop the clarity and confidence needed to make informed decisions for themselves.
